overview: Kryto Studio is a full-stack portfolio and business website for a developer/designer brand. It features a public-facing site with Home, Services, Portfolio, and Contact/Appointment pages — plus a login-protected admin panel to manage all content including portfolio uploads, client reviews, and appointment bookings.
features: Portfolio management with video uploads and website links by service type
Separate portfolio sections per service (Web/App Dev, Video Editing, Graphics Design, UI/UX)
Client reviews with star ratings on Services page
Appointment booking with name, phone, email, service type, date/time, project description
Home page with hero section and brand intro
One-page scroll Services section with reviews
